title: Parliament Passes Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill 2026
summary: Extends statutory protection under 1971 Act to National Song 'Vande Mataram'.

blocks.content: Extends statutory protection under 1971 Act to National Song 'Vande Mataram'.

items: Criminal Offence: Intentional insult, prevention, or disruption of Vande Mataram rendition carries up to 3 years imprisonment or fine.
Repeat Conviction: Mandatory minimum 1-year jail term.
Singing Clarification: Bill criminalises deliberate insult/obstruction, NOT the choice not to sing.
